page: Microsoft Azure EC64ads_cc_v5 is a memory-optimized server belonging to the ECADCCV5 family. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor with a clock speed of 3.525 GHz, 32 physical cores, and 2 threads per core. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core. It includes 2458 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core capabilities and memory performance. The server achieved a top-tier rating in the PassMark memory score and strong ratings in stress-ng multi-core CPU performance, PassMark database operations, and Redis SET operations. However, single-core performance, such as the Geekbench single-core score and single-threaded gzip compression, falls into the average category. Large-block uncached memory bandwidth also registers as average.

While the server excels at multi-threaded tasks like software compilation and ray tracing, it exhibits limitations in large-scale machine learning, specifically scoring in the bottom 25% for text generation using large (70B) LLM models. Given its high memory density and local storage capacity, this server is qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-intensive workloads that do not require GPU acceleration. It is best suited for database operations, memory-cached applications, multi-threaded data processing, and software development pipelines.
